intro.en: This text by Shaykh Ali at-Tantawi advises a young man to look at his friends and sort them. Some friends help your religion and your life, some only help one, and some help neither. The writer compares friends to air, food, medicine, wine and disease.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Shaykh Ali at-Tantawi naujawan ko nasihat karte hain ke apne doston ko parakh kar un ki qismein banaye. Kuch dost deen aur dunya dono mein faida dete hain, kuch sirf ek mein, aur kuch kisi mein nahin. Mussannif dosti ko hawa, ghiza, dawa, sharab aur bimari se tashbeeh deta hai.
intro.ar: يَنْصَحُ الشَّيْخُ عَلي الطَّنْطاوِيُّ في هذا النَّصِّ الشّابَّ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ في أَصْدِقائِهِ وَيُصَنِّفَهُمْ: مِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْفَعُ الدّينَ وَالدُّنْيا، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْفَعُ أَحَدَهُما، وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لا يَنْفَعُ بِشَيْءٍ. وَيُشَبِّهُهُمْ بِالهَواءِ وَالغِذاءِ وَالدَّواءِ وَالخَمْرِ وَالدّاءِ.

dialogue.ar: خُذْ قَلَماً وَوَرَقَةً، وَحاوِلْ أَنْ تَكْتُبَ أَسْماءَ أَصْدِقائِكَ جَميعاً أَيُّهَا الشّابُّ، ثُمَّ صَنِّفْهُمْ أَصْنافاً.
dialogue.tr: khudh qalaman wa waraqatan, wa ḥāwil an taktuba asmāʾa aṣdiqāʾika jamīʿan ayyuhā sh-shābb, thumma ṣannifhum aṣnāfan
dialogue.en: Take a pen and a paper, young man, and try to write the names of all your friends, then sort them into kinds.
dialogue.ur: Aye naujawan, qalam aur kaghaz lo aur apne tamam doston ke naam likhne ki koshish karo, phir unhein qismon mein baant do.

dialogue.ar: فَمِنْهُمْ رَفيقٌ تُقابِلُهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَمامَكَ في السَّيّارَةِ أَوِ الحافِلَةِ، يُحَيّيكَ فَتُحَيّيهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-minhum rafīqun tuqābiluhu kulla yawmin amāmaka fi s-sayyārati awi l-ḥāfila, yuḥayyīka fa-tuḥayyīh
dialogue.en: Among them is a companion you meet every day in front of you in the car or bus; he greets you and you greet him.
dialogue.ur: Un mein ek saathi hai jis se roz gaari ya bus mein mulaqat hoti hai; woh tumhein salaam karta hai aur tum use.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمْ رَفيقُ العَمَلِ، فَتَراهُ في مَكْتَبٍ بِجانِبِ مَكْتَبِكَ.
dialogue.tr: wa minhum rafīqu l-ʿamal, fa-tarāhu fī maktabin bi-jānibi maktabik
dialogue.en: And among them is a work colleague, whom you see at a desk next to yours.
dialogue.ur: Aur un mein kaam ka saathi hai, jo tumhari mez ke bagal mein baithta hai.

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا أَرَدْتَ الصِّفَةَ الَّتي تَجْمَعُ خِلالَ الخَيْرِ، فَاكْتُبْ أَسْماءَ أَصْدِقائِكَ وَأَصْحابِكَ، وَانْظُرْ إِلى كُلِّ واحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ: هَلْ هُوَ صالِحٌ في نَفْسِهِ أَمْ غَيْرُ صالِحٍ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-idhā aradta ṣ-ṣifata llatī tajmaʿu khilāla l-khayr, faktub asmāʾa aṣdiqāʾika wa aṣḥābik, wanẓur ilā kulli wāḥidin minhum: hal huwa ṣāliḥun fī nafsihi am ghayru ṣāliḥ?
dialogue.en: If you want the quality that gathers the traits of goodness, write the names of your friends and companions and look at each one: is he good in himself or not?
dialogue.ur: Agar tum woh sifat chahte ho jo bhalai ki khoobiyan jama kare, to doston ke naam likho aur har ek ko dekho: kya woh khud nek hai ya nahin?

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ هُوَ مُخْلِصٌ لِصَديقِهِ، أَمْ هُوَ لا يَهْتَمُّ إِلّا بِنَفْعِ نَفْسِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal huwa mukhliṣun li-ṣadīqih, am huwa lā yahtammu illā bi-nafʿi nafsih?
dialogue.en: And is he sincere to his friend, or does he care only about benefiting himself?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya woh apne dost ke liye mukhlis hai, ya sirf apne faide ka khayal rakhta hai?

dialogue.ar: وَجَدْتَ فيهِمْ مَنْ هُوَ صائِمٌ مُصَلٍّ لَهُ سَمْتُ المُتَّقينَ، وَلكِنَّهُ يَتَّخِذُ ذلِكَ سُلَّماً لِلدُّنْيا وَشَبَكَةً لِلمالِ.
dialogue.tr: wajadta fīhim man huwa ṣāʾimun muṣallin lahu samtu l-muttaqīn, wa lākinnahu yattakhidhu dhālika sullaman li-d-dunyā wa shabakatan lil-māl
dialogue.en: You find among them one who fasts and prays and looks like the God-fearing, but he uses that as a ladder to worldly gain and a net for money.
dialogue.ur: Un mein koi roza-namaz wala milega jo muttaqiyon jaisa dikhta hai, lekin woh isay dunya ki seedhi aur maal ka jaal bana leta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَوَجَدْتَ فيهِمْ مَنْ يَبْدو أَنَّهُ صادِقُ المُعامَلَةِ، أَمينُ اليَدِ، لكِنَّهُ لا يَصومُ وَلا يُصَلّي.
dialogue.tr: wa wajadta fīhim man yabdū annahu ṣādiqu l-muʿāmala, amīnu l-yad, lākinnahu lā yaṣūmu wa lā yuṣallī
dialogue.en: And you find one who seems honest in dealing and trustworthy, but he does not fast or pray.
dialogue.ur: Aur koi aisa jo muamle mein sacha aur amanatdaar lagta hai, lekin na roza rakhta hai na namaz padhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَوَجَدْتَ فيهِمْ مَنْ هُوَ صالِحٌ مُتَعَبِّدٌ، أَمينٌ صادِقُ المُعامَلَةِ، وَلكِنَّهُ صاحِبُ شَهْوَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa wajadta fīhim man huwa ṣāliḥun mutaʿabbid, amīnun ṣādiqu l-muʿāmala, wa lākinnahu ṣāḥibu shahwa
dialogue.en: And one who is righteous and devout, trustworthy and honest, but who is a man of desires.
dialogue.ur: Aur koi nek, ibadat guzar, amanatdaar aur sacha, lekin khwahishat ka ghulam.

dialogue.ar: وَوَجَدْتَ مَنْ هُوَ صالِحٌ في نَفْسِهِ، أَمينٌ في مُعامَلَتِهِ، لكِنَّهُ لا يَنْفَعُ صَديقاً، وَلا يُسْعِدُ صاحِباً.
dialogue.tr: wa wajadta man huwa ṣāliḥun fī nafsih, amīnun fī muʿāmalatih, lākinnahu lā yanfaʿu ṣadīqan wa lā yusʿidu ṣāḥiban
dialogue.en: And one who is good himself and honest in dealing, but does not benefit a friend or make a companion happy.
dialogue.ur: Aur koi khud nek aur muamle mein amanatdaar, lekin dost ko na faida deta hai na khush rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَوَجَدْتَ مَنْ هُوَ أَحْمَقُ أَوْ فاحِشٌ.
dialogue.tr: wa wajadta man huwa aḥmaqu aw fāḥish
dialogue.en: And you find one who is foolish or indecent.
dialogue.ur: Aur koi bewaqoof ya be-hayai ki baatein karne wala.

dialogue.ar: وَوَجَدْتَ فيهِمْ مَنْ هُوَ صالِحٌ في نَفْسِهِ، أَمينٌ في مُعامَلَتِهِ، صادِقٌ في قَوْلِهِ، يَنْفَعُ صَديقَهُ وَيُسْعِدُ صاحِبَهُ، فاظْفَرْ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa wajadta fīhim man huwa ṣāliḥun fī nafsih, amīnun fī muʿāmalatih, ṣādiqun fī qawlih, yanfaʿu ṣadīqahu wa yusʿidu ṣāḥibah, fāẓfar bih
dialogue.en: And you find one who is good himself, honest in dealing, truthful in speech, who benefits his friend and makes his companion happy: hold on to him!
dialogue.ur: Aur koi khud nek, muamle mein amanatdaar, baat mein sacha, dost ko faida aur khushi dene wala: use hasil kar lo!

dialogue.ar: وَالخُلاصَةُ أَنَّ الأَصْحابَ خَمْسَةٌ: فَصاحِبٌ كَالهَواءِ لا يُسْتَغْنى عَنْهُ، وَصَديقٌ كَالغِذاءِ، وَصاحِبٌ كَالدَّواءِ، وَصاحِبٌ كَالخَمْرِ، وَصاحِبٌ كَالبَلاءِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-khulāṣatu anna l-aṣḥāba khamsa: fa-ṣāḥibun kal-hawāʾi lā yustaghnā ʿanh, wa ṣadīqun kal-ghidhāʾ, wa ṣāḥibun kad-dawāʾ, wa ṣāḥibun kal-khamr, wa ṣāḥibun kal-balāʾ
dialogue.en: In short, companions are five: one like air that you cannot do without, one like food, one like medicine, one like wine, and one like a disaster.
dialogue.ur: Khulasa yeh ke saathi paanch hain: ek hawa jaisa jis ke bina guzara nahin, ek ghiza jaisa, ek dawa jaisa, ek sharab jaisa, aur ek museebat jaisa.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الَّذي كَالهَواءِ فَهُوَ يُفيدُكَ في دينِكَ وَيَنْفَعُكَ في دُنْياكَ.
dialogue.tr: ammā lladhī kal-hawāʾi fa-huwa yufīduka fī dīnika wa yanfaʿuka fī dunyāk
dialogue.en: The one like air benefits you in your religion and helps you in your worldly life.
dialogue.ur: Jo hawa jaisa hai woh tumhein deen mein faida aur dunya mein madad deta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمّا الَّذي هُوَ كَالدَّواءِ فَهُوَ الَّذي تَضْطَرُّكَ الحاجَةُ إِلَيْهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ammā lladhī huwa kad-dawāʾi fa-huwa lladhī taḍṭarruka l-ḥājatu ilayh
dialogue.en: The one like medicine is the one you need out of necessity.
dialogue.ur: Aur jo dawa jaisa hai woh woh hai jis ki zaroorat tumhein majboor kar de.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمّا الَّذي هُوَ كَالبَلاءِ فَهُوَ الَّذي لا يَنْفَعُكَ في دُنْيا وَلا دينٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa ammā lladhī huwa kal-balāʾi fa-huwa lladhī lā yanfaʿuka fī dunyā wa lā dīn
dialogue.en: The one like a disaster does not benefit you in worldly life or in religion.
dialogue.ur: Aur jo museebat jaisa hai woh na dunya mein faida deta hai na deen mein.

dialogue.ar: عَلَيْكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الدّينَ مِقْياساً، وَرِضا اللهِ ميزاناً.
dialogue.tr: ʿalayka an tajʿala d-dīna miqyāsan, wa riḍā llāhi mīzānā
dialogue.en: You should make religion your measure and Allah's pleasure your scale.
dialogue.ur: Tumhein chahiye ke deen ko paimana aur Allah ki raza ko tarazu banao.

vocab.en: he is useful to, he helps

q.ar: في النَّصِّ، الصَّديقُ الَّذي يُشْبِهُ الهَواءَ هُوَ الَّذي:

options: helps you in religion and worldly life

q.en: What does «يُصَنِّفُ» mean?
q.ur: «يُصَنِّفُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How many kinds of companions does the writer summarise?
q.ur: Mussannif ne saathiyon ki kitni qismein khulase mein bayan ki hain?
q.ar: كَمْ نَوْعاً مِنَ الرُّفَقاءِ لَخَّصَ الكاتِبُ؟

q.en: What does the writer say we should make our measure?
q.ur: Mussannif ke mutabiq hamein kya paimana banana chahiye?

q.en: Which word means "trustworthy"?
q.ur: "Amanatdaar" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?

intro.en: The small word «لا» is used in many ways. It can forbid («لا تُهْمِلْ» – do not neglect), deny a verb, deny a whole kind of thing («لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» – there is no doubt in it), work like «لَيْسَ», be extra with no effect, or simply answer "no" to a question.
intro.ur: Chhota sa lafz «لا» kai tarah istemal hota hai. Yeh mana kar sakta hai («لا تُهْمِلْ» – ghaflat na karo), fail ki nafi kar sakta hai, poori jins ki nafi («لا رَيْبَ فيهِ» – is mein koi shak nahin), «لَيْسَ» ki tarah amal kar sakta hai, ya zaid ho sakta hai, ya sawal ka jawab "nahin" ho sakta hai.
intro.ar: لِكَلِمَةِ «لا» اسْتِعْمالاتٌ كَثيرَةٌ: فَقَدْ تَنْهى مِثْلَ «لا تُهْمِلْ»، أَوْ تَنْفي الفِعْلَ، أَوْ تَنْفي الجِنْسَ كُلَّهُ مِثْلَ «لا رَيْبَ فيهِ»، أَوْ تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ «لَيْسَ»، أَوْ تَكونُ زائِدَةً لا أَثَرَ لَها، أَوْ تَكونُ جَواباً بِمَعْنى «لا» عَلى سُؤالٍ.

dialogue.ar: لا تُهْمِلْ دُروسَكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tuhmil durūsak
dialogue.en: Do not neglect your lessons. («لا» of prohibition)
dialogue.ur: Apne sabaq mein ghaflat na karo. (لا nahi ke liye)

dialogue.ar: لا تَعْصِ والِدَيْكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā taʿṣi wālidayk
dialogue.en: Do not disobey your parents.
dialogue.ur: Apne walidain ki nafarmani na karo.

dialogue.ar: لا تُفارِقِ الجَماعَةَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tufāriqi l-jamāʿa
dialogue.en: Do not leave the community.
dialogue.ur: Jamaat se alag na ho.

dialogue.ar: لا جامِعَةَ إِلّا مُغْلَقَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: lā jāmiʿata illā mughlaqa
dialogue.en: There is no university but a closed one. («لا» with no effect)
dialogue.ur: Koi university nahin magar band. (لا zaid)

dialogue.ar: أَتَعْرِفُ الرَّجُلَ؟ لا.
dialogue.tr: a-taʿrifu r-rajul? lā
dialogue.en: Do you know the man? No.
dialogue.ur: Kya tum us aadmi ko jante ho? Nahin.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ غادَرَ المُسافِرُ؟ لا.
dialogue.tr: hal ghādara l-musāfir? lā
dialogue.en: Has the traveller left? No.
dialogue.ur: Kya musafir chala gaya? Nahin.

vocab.en: negating the whole class (no ... at all)

intro.en: Part one is a sermon addressed to young people about choosing friends; part two is a short story called «طُرْفَة». After listening you mark each sentence true or false. The lesson ends with a writing task: prepare a short speech (خُطْبَة) on a topic you choose.
intro.ur: Pehla hissa naujawanon ke naam khutba hai jo dost chunne ke baare mein hai; doosra hissa chhoti kahani «طُرْفَة» hai. Sun kar har jumle ko sahih ya ghalat batana hota hai. Aakhir mein likhne ka kaam hai: apni pasand ke mauzu par chhota khutba tayyar karo.
intro.ar: الجُزْءُ الأَوَّلُ خُطْبَةٌ لِلشَّبابِ عَنِ اخْتِيارِ الأَصْدِقاءِ، وَالثّاني قِصَّةٌ قَصيرَةٌ اسْمُها «طُرْفَة». بَعْدَ الِاسْتِماعِ تَحْكُمُ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ. وَيَنْتَهي الدَّرْسُ بِتَمْرينِ كِتابَةٍ: حَضِّرْ خُطْبَةً قَصيرَةً في مَوْضوعٍ تَخْتارُهُ.

dialogue.ar: الصّاحِبُ كَصاحِبِهِ في الخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ.
dialogue.tr: aṣ-ṣāḥibu ka-ṣāḥibihi fi l-khayri wash-sharr
dialogue.en: A companion is like his companion in good and in evil.
dialogue.ur: Saathi apne saathi jaisa hota hai, achhai aur burai mein.

dialogue.ar: قَدْ يَحْمِلُ العاصي أَوْزارَ مَنْ قَلَّدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: qad yaḥmilu l-ʿāṣī awzāra man qalladuh
dialogue.en: A sinner may carry the burdens of sins of those who imitate him.
dialogue.ur: Gunahgaar un logon ke gunahon ka bojh bhi utha sakta hai jo us ki naqal karte hain.

dialogue.ar: حَثَّ الخَطيبُ أَوْلِياءَ أُمورِ الشَّبابِ عَلى اخْتِيارِ أَصْحابِ أَوْلادِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaththa l-khaṭību awliyāʾa umūri sh-shabābi ʿalā ikhtiyāri aṣḥābi awlādihim
dialogue.en: The preacher urged the guardians of young people to choose their children's companions.
dialogue.ur: Khateeb ne naujawanon ke sarparaston ko apne bachon ke saathi chunne par ubhara.

dialogue.ar: حَثَّ الإِسْلامُ عَلى الاسْتِفادَةِ مِنْ أَوْقاتِ الفَراغِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaththa l-islāmu ʿalā l-istifādati min awqāti l-farāgh
dialogue.en: Islam urged making good use of free time.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne khali waqt se faida uthane par ubhara.

dialogue.ar: عَزَمَ الرَّجُلُ عَلى السَّفَرِ إِلى مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةِ لِلزِّيارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ʿazama r-rajulu ʿalā s-safari ilā makkata l-mukarrama liz-ziyāra
dialogue.en: The man resolved to travel to Makkah for a visit.
dialogue.ur: Us aadmi ne ziyarat ke liye Makkah Mukarramah ke safar ka irada kiya.

dialogue.ar: اسْتَوْدَعَ الرَّجُلُ الرَّجُلَ أَوْلادَهُ وَمالَهُ.
dialogue.tr: istawdaʿa r-rajulu r-rajula awlādahu wa mālah
dialogue.en: The man entrusted the other man with his children and his money.
dialogue.ur: Us aadmi ne doosre aadmi ke paas apne bachche aur maal amanat rakhe.

dialogue.ar: طَلَبَ القاضي إِياساً مِنَ المُشْتَكي أَنْ يَعودَ إِلَيْهِ بَعْدَ يَوْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: ṭalaba l-qāḍī iyāsan mina l-mushtakī an yaʿūda ilayhi baʿda yawm
dialogue.en: The judge asked the complainant to come back to him after a day.
dialogue.ur: Qazi ne shikayat karne wale se kaha ke ek din baad dobara aaye.

q.en: What does «خُطْبَةٌ» mean?

intro.en: «كادَ» and its sisters work like «كانَ»: they take a subject (اسْم) and a predicate (خَبَر), but the predicate is usually a present-tense verb. There are three groups. Nearness: «كادَ التَّمْرُ يَطيبُ» (the dates almost ripened). Hope: «عَسى اللهُ أَنْ يَرْحَمَنا» (perhaps Allah will have mercy on us). Starting: «شَرَعَ الطِّفْلُ يَبْكي» (the child began to cry).
intro.ur: «كادَ» aur us ki behnein «كانَ» ki tarah kaam karti hain: inka ism aur khabar hota hai, lekin khabar aam taur par mudhare fail hoti hai. Teen gurooh hain. Qurb: «كادَ التَّمْرُ يَطيبُ» (khajoor pakne ke qareeb tha). Ummeed: «عَسى اللهُ أَنْ يَرْحَمَنا» (shayad Allah hum par raham kare). Shuru karna: «شَرَعَ الطِّفْلُ يَبْكي» (bachcha rone laga).
intro.ar: «كادَ» وَأَخَواتُها تَعْمَلُ عَمَلَ «كانَ»: لَها اسْمٌ وَخَبَرٌ، وَالخَبَرُ فِعْلٌ مُضارِعٌ غالِباً. وَهِيَ ثَلاثُ مَجْموعاتٍ: المُقارَبَةُ مِثْلَ «كادَ التَّمْرُ يَطيبُ»، وَالرَّجاءُ مِثْلَ «عَسى اللهُ أَنْ يَرْحَمَنا»، وَالشُّروعُ مِثْلَ «شَرَعَ الطِّفْلُ يَبْكي».

dialogue.ur: Khajoor pakne hi wali thi. (qurb)

dialogue.en: The teacher was almost a messenger.
dialogue.ur: Ustad qareeb tha ke paigambar jaisa ho.

dialogue.ar: أَوْشَكَ الوَقْتُ أَنْ يَنْقَضِيَ.
dialogue.tr: awshaka l-waqtu an yanqaḍiya

dialogue.en: Perhaps Allah will have mercy on us. (hope)

dialogue.tr: ʿasā l-khiṣbu yadūm
dialogue.en: Perhaps fertility will last.
dialogue.ur: Shayad shadabi qaim rahe.

dialogue.ar: حَرى الغائِبُ أَنْ يَحْضُرَ.
dialogue.tr: ḥarā l-ghāʾibu an yaḥḍur
dialogue.en: The absent one is likely to come.
dialogue.ur: Gaib shakhs ke aane ka imkaan hai.

dialogue.en: The child began to cry. (starting)

dialogue.en: The flowers began to open.

dialogue.en: The trees began to grow.

dialogue.en: The teacher began to explain the lesson.
dialogue.ur: Ustad ne sabaq samjhana shuru kiya.

title.en: Extensive reading: In the Holy Land

intro.en: In this travel reflection the writer visits Makkah and Madinah and remembers the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions. He walks around the Kaaba, the Sa'i between Safa and Marwa, and visits al-Baqi' and Mu'ta in his thoughts. The text is rich in emotion and in new vocabulary.
intro.ur: Is safar-nama mein mussannif Makkah aur Madinah ki ziyarat karta hai aur Nabi ﷺ aur sahaba ko yaad karta hai. Woh Kaaba ka tawaf, Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sa'i, aur Baqi' aur Mu'ta ko yaad karta hai. Yeh matan jazbat aur naye alfaz se bharpoor hai.
intro.ar: في هذِهِ الخاطِرَةِ مِنْ أَدَبِ الرِّحْلاتِ يَزورُ الكاتِبُ مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةَ وَيَتَذَكَّرُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ وَأَصْحابَهُ. يَطوفُ بِالكَعْبَةِ، وَيَسْعى بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ، وَيَزورُ البَقيعَ وَمُؤْتَةَ في خَيالِهِ. وَالنَّصُّ غَنِيٌّ بِالعاطِفَةِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ الجَديدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: هاهُنا كانَتْ بِئْرُ زَمْزَمَ تَشِحُّ، وَتَكادُ تَغيضُ، فَحَفَرْناها فَتَدَفَّقَتْ.
dialogue.tr: hāhunā kānat biʾru zamzama tashiḥḥ, wa takādu taghīḍ, fa-ḥafarnāhā fa-tadaffaqat
dialogue.en: Here the well of Zamzam was running scarce and nearly dried up; we dug it and it gushed.
dialogue.ur: Yahan Zamzam ka kuan kam pad gaya tha aur sookhne ko tha; humne use khoda to woh phoot pada.

dialogue.ar: هاهُنا كانَتِ الكَعْبَةُ عارِيَةً، فَنَسَجْنا لَها رِداءً مِنْ عُيونِنا وَكَسَوْناها.
dialogue.tr: hāhunā kānati l-kaʿbatu ʿāriya, fa-nasajnā lahā ridāʾan min ʿuyūninā wa kasawnāhā
dialogue.en: Here the Kaaba was bare; we wove it a covering from our eyes and clothed it.
dialogue.ur: Yahan Kaaba be-libas thi; humne apni aankhon se us ke liye chadar buni aur use dhaanp diya.

dialogue.ar: هاهُنا كانَ الرَّسولُ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ يَسْجُدُ لِلَّهِ.
dialogue.tr: hāhunā kāna r-rasūlu muḥammadun ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama yasjudu lillāh
dialogue.en: Here the Messenger Muhammad ﷺ used to prostrate to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Yahan Rasool Muhammad ﷺ Allah ke liye sajda karte the.

dialogue.ar: وَطُفْنا بِالكَعْبَةِ المُشَرَّفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ṭufnā bil-kaʿbati l-musharrafa
dialogue.en: And we circled the honoured Kaaba.
dialogue.ur: Aur humne muazzam Kaaba ka tawaf kiya.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّكَ تَشْعُرُ وَأَنْتَ بَيْنَ النّاسِ في الزِّحامِ، أَنَّكَ أَصْبَحْتَ أَشَدَّ قُوَّةً.
dialogue.tr: innaka tashʿuru wa anta bayna n-nāsi fiz-zḥām, annaka aṣbaḥta ashadda quwwa
dialogue.en: You feel, among the people in the crowd, that you have become stronger.
dialogue.ur: Bheed mein logon ke darmiyan tum mehsoos karte ho ke tum zyada taqatwar ho gaye ho.

dialogue.ar: وَمَضَيْنا لِلسَّعْيِ بَيْنَ الصَّفا وَالمَرْوَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa maḍaynā lis-saʿyi bayna ṣ-ṣafā wal-marwa
dialogue.en: And we went on to the Sa'i between Safa and Marwa.
dialogue.ur: Aur hum Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan sa'i ke liye chale.

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ أَسيرُ في بُطْءٍ، وَأَعْتَمِدُ عَلى عُكّازٍ، لِأَنّي كُنْتُ أُعاني بَقايا الشَّلَلِ.
dialogue.tr: kuntu asīru fī buṭʾ, wa aʿtamidu ʿalā ʿukkāz, li-annī kuntu uʿānī baqāyā sh-shalal
dialogue.en: I used to walk slowly, leaning on a crutch, because I suffered the remains of paralysis.
dialogue.ur: Main aahista chalta tha aur besakhi par tekta tha, kyunke mujhe falij ke asraat ki takleef thi.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الآنَ فَأَنا أَطيرُ طَيَراناً، أَجْري جَرْياً، أَسْبِقُ الشَّبابَ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-āna fa-anā aṭīru ṭayarānan, ajrī jaryan, asbiqu sh-shabāb
dialogue.en: But now I fly like flying, I run, I outpace the young.
dialogue.ur: Lekin ab main udta hoon, daudta hoon, aur naujawanon se aage nikal jata hoon.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ رَسولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَنْظُرُ إِلى السَّماءِ ثُمَّ إِلى الأَرْضِ، وَيَقولُ: «صَبْراً آلَ ياسِرٍ، فَإِنَّ مَوْعِدَكُمُ الجَنَّةُ».
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu rasūla llāhi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama yanẓuru ilā s-samāʾi thumma ilā l-arḍ, wa yaqūl: ṣabran āla yāsir, fa-inna mawʿidakumu l-janna
dialogue.en: I imagined hearing the Messenger of Allah ﷺ looking at the sky then the earth and saying: "Patience, family of Yasir, your promised place is Paradise."
dialogue.ur: Main ne goya Rasoolullah ﷺ ko aasman aur zameen ki taraf dekhte aur kehte suna: «Sabr karo aal-e-Yasir, tumhara thikana Jannat hai».

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ بِلالاً يُرْسِلُ صَوْتَهُ العَذْبَ القَوِيَّ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu bilālan yursilu ṣawtahu l-ʿadhba l-qawī
dialogue.en: I heard Bilal sending out his sweet, strong voice.
dialogue.ur: Main ne Bilal ko apni meethi aur mazboot aawaz buland karte suna.

dialogue.ar: هُنا سَمِعْتُ أَبا بَكْرٍ الصِّدّيقَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ يَقولُ بِصَوْتِهِ الهَدّارِ بِالإيمانِ.
dialogue.tr: hunā samiʿtu abā bakrin aṣ-ṣiddīqa raḍiya llāhu ʿanhu yaqūlu bi-ṣawtihi l-haddāri bil-īmān
dialogue.en: Here I heard Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him, speaking with his voice thundering with faith.
dialogue.ur: Yahan main ne Abu Bakr as-Siddiq (Allah un se raazi ho) ko imaan se gunjti aawaz mein bolte suna.

dialogue.ar: وَمَضَيْتُ إِلى البَقيعِ، وَوَقَفْتُ أَمامَ أَسْوارِهِ وَجُدْرانِهِ مُتَسائِلاً.
dialogue.tr: wa maḍaytu ilā l-baqīʿ, wa waqaftu amāma aswārihi wa judrānihi mutasāʾilā
dialogue.en: I went to al-Baqi' and stood before its walls, wondering.
dialogue.ur: Main Baqi' gaya aur us ki deewaron ke samne sochta hua khara raha.

dialogue.ar: قُمْتُ بِوَداعِ المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ، وَتَضَرَّعْتُ إِلى اللهِ أَنْ أَعودَ وَأَعودَ.
dialogue.tr: qumtu bi-wadāʿi l-madīnati l-munawwara, wa taḍarraʿtu ilā llāhi an aʿūda wa aʿūd
dialogue.en: I bade farewell to Madinah the Illuminated and begged Allah that I return again and again.
dialogue.ur: Main ne Madinah Munawwarah ko alvida kaha aur Allah se dua ki ke main baar baar wapas aaun.

dialogue.ar: غَداً، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ، سَأَشُدُّ الرِّحالَ إِلى مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةِ لِأَداءِ العُمْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ghadan, in shāʾa llāh, sa-ashuddu r-riḥāla ilā makkata l-mukarrama li-adāʾi l-ʿumra
dialogue.en: Tomorrow, God willing, I will set out for Makkah to perform Umrah.
dialogue.ur: Kal, insha-Allah, main Umrah ada karne ke liye Makkah Mukarramah ka safar karunga.

intro.en: This section is the third test of the book (units 9 to 12). It has reading passages with questions, grammar practice on «لا», «كادَ» and its sisters, and vocabulary. Here you review a short passage about Salman al-Farisi and the Trench, and the word «العَوْلَمَة» (globalisation).
intro.ur: Yeh hissa kitab ka teesra imtihan hai (wahdat 9 se 12). Is mein sawalon ke saath parhne ke matan, «لا» aur «كادَ» aur us ki behnon ki mashq, aur alfaz hain. Yahan Salman al-Farsi aur Khandaq par chhota matan, aur lafz «العَوْلَمَة» (globalisation) ki dohrai hai.
intro.ar: هذا القِسْمُ هُوَ الِاخْتِبارُ الثّالِثُ في الكِتابِ (الوَحَداتُ مِنَ التّاسِعَةِ إِلى الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ). فيهِ نُصوصٌ لِلْقِراءَةِ مَعَ أَسْئِلَةٍ، وَتَمارينُ عَلى «لا» وَ«كادَ» وَأَخَواتِها، وَمُفْرَداتٌ. نُراجِعُ هُنا نَصّاً قَصيراً عَنْ سَلْمانَ الفارِسِيِّ وَالخَنْدَقِ، وَكَلِمَةَ «العَوْلَمَة».

dialogue.ar: وُلِدَ الصَّحابِيُّ الجَليلُ سَلْمانُ الفارِسِيُّ في مَدينَةِ أَصْبَهانَ، وَخَرَجَ مِنْها باحِثاً عَنِ الدّينِ الحَقِّ.
dialogue.tr: wulida ṣ-ṣaḥābiyyu l-jalīlu salmānu l-fārisiyyu fī madīnati aṣbahān, wa kharaja minhā bāḥithan ʿani d-dīni l-ḥaqq
dialogue.en: The great Companion Salman al-Farisi was born in the city of Isfahan and left it searching for the true religion.
dialogue.ur: Jaleel-ul-qadr sahabi Salman Farsi Isfahan shehar mein paida hue aur wahan se sachay deen ki talash mein nikle.

dialogue.ar: لَمّا هاجَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ إِلى المَدينَةِ، جاءَ إِلَيْهِ وَتَحَرّى أَوْصافَهُ، فَآمَنَ بِهِ وَلازَمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: lammā hājara n-nabiyyu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama ilā l-madīna, jāʾa ilayhi wa taḥarrā awṣāfah, fa-āmana bihi wa lāzamah
dialogue.en: When the Prophet ﷺ migrated to Madinah, he came to him, checked his descriptions, believed in him and stayed with him.
dialogue.ur: Jab Nabi ﷺ ne Madinah hijrat farmai to woh un ke paas aaye, un ki sifaat ki tehqeeq ki, imaan laye aur un ke saath rahe.

dialogue.ar: قالَ: «يا رَسولَ اللهِ، إِنّا كُنّا بِأَرْضِ فارِسَ إِذا حُوصِرْنا خَنْدَقْنا عَلَيْنا.»
dialogue.tr: qāl: yā rasūla llāh, innā kunnā bi-arḍi fārisa idhā ḥūṣirnā khandaqnā ʿalaynā
dialogue.en: He said: "O Messenger of Allah, in the land of Persia, when we were besieged we dug a trench around us."
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kaha: «Ya Rasoolullah, Farisi sarzameen mein jab hum ghere jate to apne ird-gird khandaq khod lete the».

dialogue.ar: وَكَّلَ إِلى كُلِّ عَشَرَةِ رِجالٍ أَنْ يَحْفِروا مِنَ الخَنْدَقِ أَرْبَعينَ ذِراعاً.
dialogue.tr: wakkala ilā kulli ʿasharati rijālin an yaḥfirū mina l-khandaqi arbaʿīna dhirāʿā
dialogue.en: He assigned each ten men to dig forty cubits of the trench.
dialogue.ur: Har das aadmiyon ko khandaq ke chalis haath khodne ki zimmedari di gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَلَّاهُ الخَليفَةُ عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ المَدائِنَ، وَكانَ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِالمالِ الَّذي يَأْخُذُهُ مِنْ بَيْتِ المالِ.
dialogue.tr: wallāhu l-khalīfatu ʿumaru bnu l-khaṭṭābi l-madāʾin, wa kāna yataṣaddaqu bil-māli lladhī yaʾkhudhuhu min bayti l-māl
dialogue.en: The caliph Umar ibn al-Khattab appointed him over al-Mada'in, and he used to give the money he took from the treasury in charity.
dialogue.ur: Khalifa Umar bin al-Khattab ne unhein Madain ka walī banaya aur woh baitul maal se liya hua maal sadqa kar dete.

dialogue.ar: انْتَشَرَ مُصْطَلَحُ العَوْلَمَةِ في العَقْدِ الأَخيرِ مِنَ القَرْنِ العِشْرينَ.
dialogue.tr: intashara muṣṭalaḥu l-ʿawlama fi l-ʿaqdi l-akhīri mina l-qarni l-ʿishrīn
dialogue.en: The term "globalisation" spread in the last decade of the twentieth century.
dialogue.ur: «Globalisation» ki istilah bees-veen sadi ke aakhri dahaye mein phail gayi.

dialogue.ar: تَحْدُثُ العَوْلَمَةُ نَتيجَةً لِلتَّطَوُّرِ الهائِلِ في وَسائِلِ الاتِّصالِ بَيْنَ المُجْتَمَعاتِ وَالدُّوَلِ.
dialogue.tr: taḥduthu l-ʿawlamatu natījatan lit-taṭawwuri l-hāʾili fī wasāʾili l-ittiṣāli bayna l-mujtamaʿāti wad-duwal
dialogue.en: Globalisation happens as a result of the huge development in the means of communication between societies and states.
dialogue.ur: Globalisation muashiron aur mulkon ke darmiyan raabte ke zarai mein azeem taraqqi ki wajah se hoti hai.
